map.→ 打开采购（成本/节约额）分析工具: -> Open the Procurement (cost / savings) Analysis tool
map.以「8 次采购单价（元）」为例: Taking "8 purchase unit prices (CNY)" as an example
map.均值反映集中趋势；中位数对极端值更稳健；极差是最大最小之差，快速看波动范围；方差: The mean reflects the central tendency; the median is more robust against extreme values; the range is the difference between the maximum and the minimum, giving a quick view of the spread; the variance and standard deviation measure dispersion, so a larger value means supplier quotes or batch data are more scattered; a standard deviation of 0 means all the data are identical. When selecting, a low standard deviation often means more controllable cost.
map.将每次谈判的节约额（原基准价−实际成交价）汇总成数列，用均值/中位数评估整体降本: Aggregate the savings from each negotiation (original baseline price − actual deal price) into a series, use the mean and median to assess the overall cost reduction, and the standard deviation to see how stable the savings are.
map.工具算的是「节约额」吗？: Does the Tool Compute the Savings Amount?
map.录入采购价与基准价计算节约额与节约率，按品类汇总，用于降本考核与供应商比价，纯前: Enter the purchase price and the baseline price to compute the savings amount and savings rate, aggregated by category, for cost reduction assessment and supplier comparison. Pure front-end statistics, nothing leaves your browser.
map.本工具只做基础描述统计，直接对输入的数字序列计算均值/标准差等；「节约额」需你先: This tool only does basic descriptive statistics, computing the mean and standard deviation directly on the numeric sequence you enter; for the "savings amount" you must first work out each item (baseline price − deal price) yourself and paste it in. It reads no external data and runs entirely in your browser.
map.汇总多家供应商的报价后，用描述统计看分布：均值判断市场均价、标准差看报价离散度、: After aggregating quotes from several suppliers, look at the distribution with descriptive statistics: the mean gives the market average, the standard deviation shows the dispersion of quotes, and the range shows the gap between the highest and lowest, helping negotiation.
map.统计某品类近 N 次采购单价，观察均值与波动，识别异常高价批次或价格趋势。: Compute the unit price of the last N purchases of a category, observe the mean and the fluctuation, and identify abnormally expensive batches or price trends.
map.这些指标分别怎么解读？: How Is Each of These Indicators Interpreted?
map.：输入 10,20,30,40,50,60,70,80（逗号、空格或换行分隔均可: : Enter 10,20,30,40,50,60,70,80 (comma, space, or newline separators all work) → count n=8, sum=360.00, mean=45.00, median=(40+50)/2=45.00, minimum=10, maximum=80, range=70.00, variance=525.00, standard deviation=22.91. The dispersion of this price series is fairly large (standard deviation about 22.91), so the room for negotiation may be wide.
